NVDA.text: Nvidia rose 2.2% as technology and semiconductor shares rebounded ahead of its Aug. 26 earnings, helped by lower oil prices and Treasury yields; no separate Nvidia-specific catalyst was confirmed.

AVGO.text: Broadcom fell 0.6% despite a 1.4% rebound in the broader chip index, underperforming the semiconductor recovery ahead of Nvidia earnings; no fresh Broadcom-specific catalyst was confirmed.

TSM.text: TSM rose 1.8% with Tuesday's semiconductor rebound as investors moved back into technology ahead of Nvidia earnings, aided by lower oil prices and Treasury yields; no fresh TSM-specific catalyst was confirmed.

ASML.text: ASML rose 0.2% with the broader semiconductor recovery ahead of Nvidia earnings; no fresh ASML-specific catalyst was confirmed.

KLAC.text: KLA rose 1.0% with Tuesday's semiconductor rebound ahead of Nvidia earnings; no fresh KLA-specific catalyst was confirmed.

INTC.text: Intel rose 0.3% as chip stocks recovered from Monday's selloff ahead of Nvidia earnings; no fresh Intel-specific catalyst was confirmed.

MU.text: Micron rose 2.5% as semiconductor and AI-related shares rebounded ahead of Nvidia earnings, reversing part of Monday's sharp selloff; no fresh Micron-specific catalyst was confirmed.

TSLA.text: Tesla rose 0.4% in ordinary trading as the Nasdaq advanced 0.7%; no fresh Tesla-specific catalyst strong enough to explain the small move was confirmed.

META.text: Meta rose 2.0% with Tuesday's rebound in major technology stocks as lower oil prices and Treasury yields supported growth shares; no single fresh Meta-specific catalyst was confirmed.

PLTR.text: Palantir fell 1.8% despite a higher Nasdaq and a reiterated bullish Truist rating, with no confirmed fresh negative company catalyst; the move appears to have been stock-specific consolidation after recent gains.

SPCX.text: SpaceX rose 2.2% as JPMorgan reiterated an Overweight rating and highlighted progress in the company's AI roadmap, while investors also looked to Tuesday's scheduled Starlink launch.
